items.title: Transcatheter Aortic-Valve Replacement in Pure Aortic Regurgitation: The Randomized SEASON-AR Clinical Trial
items.title_zh: SEASON-AR随机对照试验:经导管主动脉瓣置换治疗单纯性主动脉瓣反流
items.summary_zh: 该研究同期发表于《Circulation》并在TCT 2026报告,由Gao XF、Wang Y、Jiang H等在中国20余家中心开展,计划入组210例合并重度原发性(非钙化性)主动脉瓣反流且外科手术高危的患者,随机分配至经股动脉自膨胀VitaFlow瓣膜经导管主动脉瓣置换(TAVR)联合指南导向药物治疗(GDMT)组,或单纯GDMT组,主要终点为12个月全因死亡、致残性卒中或心衰再住院复合终点。结果显示TAVI联合GDMT较单纯GDMT显著改善临床结局,但大/致命性出血及新发永久起搏器植入发生率更高。作者认为这是首个将TAVI+GDMT与单纯GDMT头对头比较的随机对照研究,为不适合外科手术的重度原发性主动脉瓣反流患者提供了一种安全可行的治疗选择。
items.summary_en: Published simultaneously with its TCT 2026 presentation in Circulation, the randomized SEASON-AR trial (Gao XF, Wang Y, Jiang H, et al.) enrolled patients with severe native (non-calcific) aortic regurgitation at high surgical risk across more than 20 Chinese centers, targeting 210 participants randomized to transfemoral self-expanding VitaFlow transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) plus guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) versus GDMT alone, with a 12-month composite primary endpoint of all-cause death, disabling stroke, or heart failure rehospitalization. TAVI plus GDMT significantly improved clinical outcomes versus GDMT alone, though at the cost of higher rates of major/life-threatening bleeding and new permanent pacemaker implantation. The authors say this first head-to-head randomized comparison supports TAVI plus GDMT as a safe option for inoperable patients with severe native AR.

items.title: Medtronic Presents Evolut EXPAND TAVR II Trial Design and Baseline Characteristics of Patients With Moderate Aortic Stenosis at TCT 2026
items.title_zh: 美敦力在TCT 2026公布Evolut EXPAND TAVR II研究设计及中度主动脉瓣狭窄患者基线特征
items.summary_zh: 美敦力在TCT 2026的"重点临床科学"环节公布其关键性试验Evolut EXPAND TAVR II的设计及基线特征。该国际多中心研究计划在16个国家96个中心随机入组692例年龄≥65岁、经核心实验室确认为中度主动脉瓣狭窄且合并至少一项高危特征的患者,按比例随机分为自膨胀Evolut瓣膜经导管主动脉瓣置换(TAVR)联合指南导向药物治疗组与单纯药物治疗组,主要终点为全因死亡、心衰住院/事件或因病情不稳定需行主动脉瓣置换/再介入的复合终点,30天评估安全性、2年评估有效性,随访至10年。该试验与同在TCT 2026公布的Edwards PROGRESS试验(采用球囊扩张式Sapien 3瓣膜)形成直接竞品对照;中度主动脉瓣狭窄的早期TAVR干预目前仍属试验性用途,尚未获批准。
items.summary_en: At TCT 2026's Featured Clinical Science session, Medtronic presented the design and baseline characteristics of its pivotal Evolut EXPAND TAVR II trial. The international, multicenter study is randomizing 692 patients aged 65 or older with core-lab-confirmed moderate aortic stenosis plus at least one at-risk feature across 96 sites in 16 countries to transcatheter aortic valve replacement with the self-expanding Evolut valve plus guideline-directed medical therapy versus medical therapy alone. The composite primary endpoint covers all-cause mortality, heart failure hospitalization/events, or clinical instability requiring aortic valve replacement/reintervention, with safety assessed at 30 days, effectiveness at 2 years, and follow-up to 10 years. The trial directly parallels Edwards' balloon-expandable-valve PROGRESS trial presented at the same meeting; TAVR for moderate AS remains investigational and is not yet an approved indication.

items.title: First Patients Treated in TRIUMPH Pivotal Trial of Laplace Interventional's Transcatheter Tricuspid Valve Replacement System
items.title_zh: Laplace Interventional公布TRIUMPH关键性试验首批患者完成经导管三尖瓣置换系统植入
items.summary_zh: 明尼苏达州器械公司Laplace Interventional宣布其TRIUMPH关键性临床试验(前瞻性、多中心IDE研究)随机队列的首批3例患者已完成入组及经导管三尖瓣置换(TTVR)系统植入,分别在美国田纳西州Ballad Health(术者Gaurav Rana)及俄克拉荷马Oklahoma Heart Institute(术者Kamran Muhammad)完成,受试者按比例随机分配至该器械组或已上市TTVR对照器械组。该系统可经颈静脉或股静脉入路植入,适用于瓣叶连枷/腱索断裂、瓣叶组织缺失及类癌心脏病等解剖条件。公司同期在TCT 2026公布了其经颈静脉入路早期可行性研究的1年随访数据。全球联合研究主席包括Mayo Clinic的Charanjit Rihal、范德堡大学的Kashish Goel及Providence St. Vincent医学中心的Brandon Jones。
items.summary_en: Minnesota device maker Laplace Interventional announced that the first three patients in the randomized cohort of its TRIUMPH pivotal trial — a prospective, multicenter IDE study — have been enrolled and treated with its transcatheter tricuspid valve replacement (TTVR) system, at Ballad Health in Tennessee (Gaurav Rana, MD) and the Oklahoma Heart Institute (Kamran Muhammad, MD); patients are randomized against a commercially available TTVR device. The transjugular- or transfemoral-deliverable system targets anatomies including flail/tethered leaflets, leaflet paucity, and carcinoid heart disease. The company separately presented 1-year data from its transjugular early feasibility study at TCT 2026. Global co-principal investigators include Charanjit Rihal (Mayo Clinic), Kashish Goel (Vanderbilt), and Brandon Jones (Providence St. Vincent Medical Center).

items.title: Positive New Data on Corcym's Perceval Plus Sutureless Aortic Heart Valve Encompasses up to 7-Year Follow-up
items.title_zh: Corcym Perceval Plus无缝合主动脉瓣新数据公布,随访最长达7年
items.summary_zh: 基于MANTRA登记研究(纳入45个中心708例在真实临床实践中接受Corcym Perceval Plus无缝合/快速植入主动脉瓣的患者)的最新分析显示,3至7年随访期内无结构性瓣膜退化(SVD)发生率达99.7%,4至7年免于主动脉瓣再次手术发生率为96.6%,30天永久起搏器植入率为3.7%,术后1年KCCQ-12生活质量评分较基线提升31%。该结果以企业新闻稿形式发布,尚未见同行评审论文公布完整数据,登记研究仍在持续入组中。
items.summary_en: New analysis from the MANTRA registry — 708 patients treated with Corcym's Perceval Plus sutureless/rapid-deployment aortic valve in routine clinical practice across 45 centers — reported 99.7% freedom from structural valve deterioration between 3 and 7 years, 96.6% freedom from aortic valve reoperation between 4 and 7 years, a 3.7% 30-day permanent pacemaker rate, and a 31% improvement in KCCQ-12 quality-of-life scores from baseline at 1 year. The figures come from a company press release; a peer-reviewed publication with the full data was not identified, and the registry continues to enroll.

items.title: Merit Medical Acquires Solo Pace for TAVR Pacing Technology
items.title_zh: Merit Medical收购Solo Pace,布局TAVR术中临时起搏技术
items.summary_zh: 美国器械公司Merit Medical宣布于2026年10月13日完成对明尼阿波利斯公司Solo Pace剩余全部股权的收购,交易对价约4500万美元;此前Merit已是Solo Pace的独家经销商及早期投资方。Solo Pace产品线包括SOLO PACE CONTROL体外脉冲发生器,以及集成导丝功能、左心室起搏与患者接地于一体的SOLO PACE FUSION套件(已于2026年3月商业化上市),用于简化TAVR术中临时起搏流程,公司称有助于减少因沟通失误导致的起搏错误及血管并发症。Merit预计该交易对2026财年影响不大,2027年起对非GAAP每股收益略有增厚效应。
items.summary_en: US device maker Merit Medical announced it completed the buyout of all remaining equity in Solo Pace, a Minneapolis-based maker of TAVR temporary pacing technology, on October 13, 2026, for roughly $45 million; Merit had previously been Solo Pace's exclusive distributor and an early investor. Solo Pace's portfolio includes the SOLO PACE CONTROL external pulse generator and the SOLO PACE FUSION kit — which combines guidewire function, left ventricular pacing, and patient grounding, commercially launched in March 2026 — designed to simplify intraprocedural pacing during TAVR and reduce communication-related pacing errors and vascular complications. Merit expects the deal to be immaterial to 2026 results and slightly accretive to non-GAAP EPS starting 2027.
